# Five fix rounds do not satisfy the review. The item pauses and asks the owner to rule on the open findings.
# After the answer, the settle step applies the ruling once and the run ends. The pull request is not marked ready.
env OWNER_LOGIN=owner SOURCE_CHECKOUT=/own/checkout
exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &

# The run has opened the store once the first agent call is in the record.
waitfile calls.log
waitstatus 'paused: The review loop used all of its rounds'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tpaused: The review loop used all of its rounds'
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

exec obee answer 7 keep the current API
wait
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone$'

grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 5 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 6 ' calls.log
grep -count=6 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^settle +[ab] keep the current API$' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
